I couldn't write the Proverbs 2 notes. My research tool stopped working before I could read any of the sources, so none of what you asked for (traditional readings, Protestant differences or other views) has been researched yet.

I tried to open six pages in one batch: the Enduring Word, Precept Austin and NET Bible pages on Proverbs 2, and the Ellicott, Gill and Pulpit Commentary pages on Bible Hub. A mistake in my own code meant I never displayed or checked the results. Then I hit the limit on tool calls for this turn. I can't say whether those pages loaded or what they contain, so I have nothing I can honestly report.

Your rules say to use only what I read and never to fill gaps from my own knowledge. So I haven't written any verse notes from memory, because they would come with no URLs behind them.

If you ask again, I'll start over: open each site in turn and check the results before moving on, then write the verse-by-verse notes from what I actually read. The order would be:

1. **Traditional readings:** Enduring Word, Precept Austin, and Gill, Ellicott and the Pulpit Commentary on Bible Hub and StudyLight.
2. **Protestant traditions:** Wesley's notes, Spurgeon, Ligonier and Desiring God, the Lutheran sites (LCMS, 1517) and the Pentecostal sites, wherever they comment on Proverbs 2.
3. **Other views:** NET Bible translators' notes, which probably matter most for "forbidden woman" and "stranger" in v. 16 and "departed spirits" in v. 18; Bible Odyssey on Wisdom; and Catholic and Orthodox pages, only where they comment on this chapter.
